quote: On our imaginary island, I lend seeds only after writing their planting month.
paraphrase: Record the planting month before lending.
context: Fictional first season; seed lending on the imaginary island.

quote: For first-time gardeners, I prefer one small pot to a large plot.
paraphrase: Start beginners with a small pot.
context: Applies to first-time gardeners, not experienced gardeners.

quote: When the rainy season arrives, I move the seed envelopes to a dry shelf.
paraphrase: Protect seed envelopes from the rainy season.
context: Conditional on the rainy season arriving.

quote: In the later season, I still record the planting month before lending seeds.
paraphrase: The recording practice continues in the later season.
context: Later fictional notebook; this does not establish a timeless rule.

quote: For experienced gardeners with shared tools, I now suggest a larger plot.
paraphrase: A larger plot is suggested for experienced gardeners with shared tools.
context: A later expression under different experience and equipment conditions.

quote: If the dry shelf is full, I postpone lending until the envelopes can stay dry.
paraphrase: Delay lending when dry storage is unavailable.
context: Conditional on a full dry shelf; preserve this limitation.
